authorization: User: Start all these tasks. Release publication remains prohibited until new authorization.
purpose: Improve actual obstacle detection and decision validity before final acceptance. Preserve the sealed reference; no release or automatic score target claim.

stages.name: A: diagnosis
stages.work: Trace every set O miss and all45 ride false events using fixed frozen outputs/original caches. New placement cases remain development diagnostics. Classify causes only where target-level evidence supports them; retain uncertain cases.

stages.name: B: bounded candidates
stages.work: Before implementation or candidate measurement, register exact change, hypothesis, touched files and target metrics in an append-only candidate record. Evaluate each once under its registered settings; retain failures. No search over thresholds without a new recorded experiment.

stages.name: C: acceptance
stages.work: Review patches independently; full strict gate, raw/cache comparison, paired-placement/rate/mount/start-offset checks, ROS and browser validation, independent rejudgement. Only then integrate an accepted detector and replace its seal.

freshness.scope: ROS node, launch, tests; detector package unchanged
freshness.contract: Preserve STOP priority; non-current/invalid input must not emit actionable GO. Publish queue delay and local residence age; acquisition age requires an explicitly valid clock relation. Distinguish live and historical replay. Register exact defaults separately before implementation.

missed_obstacles.scope: isolated worktree; trace corridor membership, filter rejection, clusters and temporal confirmation
missed_obstacles.target: At least two intended-inside object families improve sustained STOP distance by >=10 m or longest missed approach by >=20%, across at least two background groups where surveyed/checked geometry permits the comparison. Every existing positive gate metric must be no worse. Recompute geometry validity before interpreting approximate placements.

false_alarms.restriction: No positive regressions, no event-ID coalescing or scorer changes to manufacture fewer events. Preserve target coverage.

monitoring_validity.target: Zero actionable GO/range overclaims on independently reviewed diagnostic positives under the declared contract. Keep detection recall and diagnostic-range metrics separate. A renamed field alone is not a detection improvement.

global_gates.full_regression: All183 current gated metrics present; no worse rows or waivers against frozen baseline. Output-contract changes are separately recorded and may not conceal detection regressions.
global_gates.false_positive_nonregression: Outside-object/background STOP counts and each existing empty/ride gate row no worse.

uncertainty_cost.note: Measure on frame-aligned outputs. Prevent always-CAUTION or blanket range collapse from counting as a quality fix. Report monitored range separately.

runtime.freshness: No GO outside declared validity/freshness contract; report recording-time offsets separately from processing and source age.

global_gates.synthetic: All72 original novel-placement cases retained. No unmatched whole case or per-shape matched-frame count may worsen when comparing a detector candidate, unless independently shown out of the defined envelope and excluded in a separately preregistered geometry-correct evaluation for BOTH baseline and candidate. The original72 results must still be reported.

data_limits: No additional untouched real-obstacle recording is available (user confirmation).

reporting: Retain every measured candidate, including failed or abandoned trials.
